Build A Bot Workshop

Fri Nov 20, 2026 12:00 pm—1:00 pm
Add to Calendar
REGISTER

Presenters: Connie Steel, PhD - AI at Yale Program Manager.

Build a Bot is a hands-on workshop for participants to design and create a functional AI chatbot using generative AI tools available at Yale. Attendees will learn the fundamentals of bot design — from defining a use case and structuring instructions, to testing and refining outputs — and leave with a working bot tailored to their own research, teaching, or administrative needs. Whether the goal is to streamline a recurring task, support a course, or assist with day-to-day administrative work, this session walks through the process step by step: identifying a clear purpose, drafting effective instructions, and iterating based on real responses. No coding experience is necessary. Participants should leave the session with both a working prototype and a repeatable process they can apply to future bot-building projects.

* Lunch will be served to in person attendees (please contact jaquan.brinkley-johnson@yale.edu). Attendees are also required to bring a laptop to this workshop. Attendance will be capped at 50 people.
